questions.q:
Study the following code carefully and answer:

' check list has been generated' = 'jo ke al si ha'

'His idea has check' = 'of al fu ha'

' number in check list' = 'ha ya go ke '

'His number generated there' = ' ya si fu xo'

Which of the following may represent 'My number has been generated'?
o: (a) si ne jo ke na
(b) ya ne al ke si
(c) jo si ya al ne
(d) ne fu ya ke al
questions.s:
From all four statements: 'check' = ha (common to 1,2,3).

From statements 1 & 2: ' has' = al.

From statements 1 & 4: 'generated' = si .

From statements 1 & 3: 'list' = ke ; so 'been' = jo (left in 1).

From statements 3 & 4: 'number' = ya .

'My number has been generated' = My + ya + al + jo + si .

Option (c) 'jo si ya al ne' contains jo, si , ya , al and a new word 'ne' for 'My'.

rule = add the letter's position in the word to its alphabetical position

Map: 14→N, 3→C, 10→J, 18→R, 10→J, 26→Z → NCJRJZ
